sovereign_country.strategic_role: 制造业产业链转移第一站、保税加工（EPE）设立首选

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fractional CFO Advisory and Multicurrency Ledger Bookkeeping

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Viet Nam — unified national single-jurisdiction corporate registry; Hanoi is the administrative capital; Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City Departments of Planning and Investment (DPIs) serve as primary registration offices for foreign-invested projects
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law with socialist-oriented codified statutes; National Assembly laws and Government decrees are the primary legal sources; judicial precedent is non-binding; company law, investment law, and AML/CFT rules are in force nationally and uniformly from the date of promulgation
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) — in force for Viet Nam on 30 December 2018; includes investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS)
EU–Viet Nam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA) — in force 1 August 2020
EU–Viet Nam Investment Protection Agreement (EVIPA) — signed 30 June 2019; not yet fully ratified and not yet in force
Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) — in force for Viet Nam on 1 January 2022
ASEAN Comprehensive Investment Agreement (ACIA) — in force since 24 March 2012
UK–Viet Nam Free Trade Agreement (UKVFTA) — in force 1 May 2021
Japan–Viet Nam Bilateral Investment Agreement (2003), Korea–Viet Nam Bilateral Investment Agreement (2003), and Germany–Viet Nam Bilateral Investment Agreement (1993)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15, effective 1 March 2023; Decree No. 19/2023/NĐ-CP dated 6 June 2023 detailing AML/CFT implementation, including beneficial-owner identification thresholds; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN of the State Bank of Viet Nam on AML/CFT supervision and risk classification; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP on enterprise registration, as amended by Decree No. 122/2021/NĐ-CP; and the framework of the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation to which Viet Nam is a member.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — LLC member lists, capital contribution schedules, and beneficial-owner declarations are filed with the provincial DPI and maintained in the National Business Registration Database; such items are not published on the public business-search portal and are accessible only to state authorities, licensed information providers, and parties with a statutory need under AML/CFT procedures.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Founder's valid national or international passport — certified true copy used for identity verification and natural-person beneficial-owner identification
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Passport Authority or Ministry of Public Security of the founder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille — Viet Nam acceded to the Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961 with effect from 12 July 2023; for documents from non-Hague Contracting States, consular legalization at a Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate is mandatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police Clearance Certificate / Judicial Record Extract of the foreign founder (home-country equivalent of the Vietnamese Phiếu lý lịch tư pháp)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Police records authority / Ministry of Justice of the founder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing country is a Contracting State; otherwise consular legalization by the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent registry extract of the founder if the investor is a corporate entity ultimately owned by natural persons
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registry in the corporate founder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; must be dated within 90 days before submission to the DPI

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional credential certificate of the designated finance officer (ACCA, CPA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent) required for the fractional CFO and bookkeeping scope
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country professional accounting institute or statutory certification board
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille followed by notarized Vietnamese translation before filing with the Ministry of Finance / DPI

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified declaration of ultimate beneficial owner and source of funds for the 100% foreign charter capital contribution, executed by the founder and confirmed by the transferee bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed notary public in the founder's jurisdiction, countersigned by the remitting bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; accompanying Vietnamese translation notarized in Viet Nam

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from the founder's house bank confirming account history, beneficial ownership, and compliance standing of the remitting party for the inward FDI capital transfer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank in the founder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or banker's notarized signature certified by consular legalization where the receiving Vietnamese bank so requires

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every founder and UBO against: (i) the State Bank of Viet Nam's PEP and sanctions database established under Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN; (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) the U.S. OFAC SDN and non-SDN consolidated lists; (iv) EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists; and (v) domestic Vietnamese court and prosecutorial watchlists. Screening must be risk-based, documented in a written compliance memorandum, re-run within 24 hours before opening the corporate bank account and before activating Stripe Billing and Wise payment rails, and refreshed at least quarterly thereafter. A 'high-risk PEP proximity' finding triggers mandatory senior-management approval and enhanced ongoing monitoring of all client-source funds.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) — https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, operated by the Agency for Business Registration under the Ministry of Planning and Investment; ancillary filing interface via the National Public Service Portal at https://dichvucong.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The enterprise name must be established in Vietnamese and must contain a proper Vietnamese name together with the legal entity designation 'Công ty TNHH' for a limited liability company. Arabic numerals and symbols are permitted in the proper name. A foreign-invested LLC must additionally state its 'foreign name' in Latin script, which may be the original or transliterated name of the investor; all statutory filings are in Vietnamese. Names that are identical or confusingly similar to an already registered enterprise are prohibited under Law on Enterprises 2020 Article 40 and Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP Articles 36–42. The Vietnamese name must not consist solely of the legal entity designation and must not violate historical, cultural, or national-security sensitivities.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: "Ngân hàng" (bank) and "Tín dụng" (credit) — prior State Bank of Viet Nam approval and statutory licensing are required
"Bảo hiểm" (insurance) — prior Ministry of Finance licensing required
"Chứng khoán" (securities) and "Quỹ đầu tư" (investment fund) — prior State Securities Commission approval required
"Kiểm toán" (audit) — restricted to licensed audit firms under Decree 174/2020/NĐ-CP; prohibited without a valid audit-service eligibility certificate

"Kế toán" (accounting) — a sensitive token triggering regulated accounting-service eligibility certification under Ministry of Finance regulations before use in a company name for a bookkeeping practice
"Tổng công ty" (general corporation) — requires a decision of the Prime Minister or an enterprise established by a State body as applicable
"Nhà nước" (State), "Chính phủ" (Government), "Bộ" (Ministry) and other denomination of State authorities — prohibited for private enterprises without prior ministerial consent
Surnames of historical leaders, national heroes, or incumbent senior officials — prohibited or requiring prior familial/competent-authority consent under Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP Article 40
Words or combinations contrary to the historical and cultural traditions of Viet Nam, inciting discrimination, or containing vulgar or offensive connotations — absolutely prohibited
Names identical or confusingly similar to an existing enterprise, protected trademark, or well-known business identifier — prohibited as determined by the DPI upon name clearance
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Viet Nam does not operate a standalone time-limited name reservation system; the name is cleared and registered concurrently with the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC). Once the ERC is issued, the registered name is protected for the legal life of the entity. The 30-day window denotes the recommended statutory consolidation period after ERC issuance during which the enterprise must complete tax registration, company-seal usage notification, bank-account opening, and e-invoice activation before invoicing clients. In case of name rejection or ERC refusal: (1) obtain the DPI's written notice of rejection or amendment request (Thông báo trả hồ sơ / sửa đổi bổ sung hồ sơ); (2) file a first-level administrative complaint with the Director of the provincial DPI within 30 calendar days of receipt, under Article 26 of Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP and the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13, attaching a rectified non-conflicting name proposal; (3) require the DPI to resolve within 10 working days; (4) if unsuccessful, appeal within 10 days to the Chairman of the provincial People's Committee as the second-level complaint, determinable within 30 working days; (5) if still unsuccessful, bring an administrative lawsuit at the competent provincial People's Court under the Law on Administrative Procedures 2015 within one year of the final administrative decision; (6) in parallel, because no reservation exists, immediately re-file the corrected IRC/ERC dossier with a new name so that the earlier filing timestamp preserves precedence over later applicants.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. A pure virtual mailbox, P.O. Box, or address-only arrangement is statutorily prohibited as the head office under Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP Article 27. For an ISIC 6920 fractional-CFO and bookkeeping advisory LLC, DPI and tax authorities accept a serviced-office lease or co-working space with a physical reception, a dedicated desk, a 12-month or longer lease term, and a responsible officer reachable during working hours. A nominee-address-only structure is high-risk and triggers tax re-registration audits and fiscal-field inspections; a grade-B commercial serviced office in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi (for example Bitexco Financial Tower, Saigon Centre, or an equivalent licensed serviced-office building) is the recommended commercial-substance solution.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: an estimated 20–30% probability of an unannounced on-site address-verification check during the first 12 months of operation for a low-risk professional-services LLC registered in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City; the probability escalates to approximately 45–50% if the registered address is a virtual-office-only arrangement without any staff presence or physical lease; inspections arise from DPI address-verification campaigns and tax-authority e-invoice compliance programs effective from the 2024 assessment cycle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) filing for a 100% foreign-owned LLC in a non-conditional professional-services sector (ISIC 6920)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) — Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory: no state filing fee is assessed for ordinary investment registration under the Law on Fees and Charges No. 97/2015/QH13 and the Ministry of Finance fee circulars; appraisal fees apply only to conditional or incentive-requiring projects.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) issuance and automated tax-identification-number assignment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial DPI and General Department of Taxation via automatic TIN linkage
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory: ERC issuance is not subject to a state fee under Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP; the only mandatory charge is the publication fee listed below.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory publication of enterprise registration content on the National Business Registration Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National Business Registration Portal / Ministry of Planning and Investment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: VND 30,000 (~USD 1.3) per publication under Circular 47/2019/TT-BTC.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Vietnamese notarization and translation of founder passport, corporate good-standing certificates, professional qualifications, lease contract, power of attorney, and beneficial-owner declarations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed notary public office in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: USD 120–180 per incorporation dossier, approximating VND 3.0–4.5 million.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certification of founder passport, police clearance, professional certificates, and corporate good-standing documents (estimated three apostilles)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the document's country of origin (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State or UK FCDO Legalisation Office)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official statutory fees usually ranging from USD 15 to USD 40 per document, depending on the issuing jurisdiction.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization contingency at the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate for documents originating in non-Hague jurisdictions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Embassy or Consulate of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam in the founder's jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory Vietnamese consular fee schedule: approximately USD 40–60 per document plus local courier and processing service fees.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Enterprise Law 2020), Articles 25 (Enterprise Registration Application), 26 (Contents of Application), 29 (Issuance of Enterprise Registration Certificate), 58 (Limited Liability Company with Two or More Members), 61 (Limited Liability Company with One Member); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 22-24 (Investment Registration Certificate for Foreign Investors); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-governed city where the registered office will be located; online submission via the National Business Registration Portal (doanhnghiep.gov.vn / ict.doanhnghiep.gov.vn), operated by the Business Registration Administration of the Ministry of Planning and Investment
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) submitted together with the company charter and constituent documents on the National Business Registration Portal or in person to the DPI
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital applies to a foreign-invested limited liability company providing professional virtual CFO and bookkeeping services. The charter capital may be freely determined by the founders but must be fully paid in within 90 days after issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, in accordance with Article 26 of the Law on Investment. For service businesses, capital must be sufficient to cover implementation costs and registered operational scope.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate (For Foreign-Invested Company)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city where the project is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an investment project dossier through the National Investment Portal or directly to DPI. The dossier must include a written investor proposal, certificate of incorporation and passport of the investor, legal copy of the enterprise charter, land lease / office lease agreement, and evidence of financial capacity. DPI will issue an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) if the project satisfies market access conditions and investment conditions applicable to the virtual CFO and bookkeeping service sector. The procedure may be handled under the 'registration' regime for standard service sectors not subject to investment screening.
required_dossiers: Written investment proposal explaining the project
Investor legal documents (foreign certificate of incorporation / individual passport)
Certified copy of the proposed company charter
National Identity Card/Passport of legal representative
Office lease agreement or letter of intent, with landlord ownership certificate
Financial capacity evidence (bank statement, audited accounts or written commitment by investor)
Economic needs explanation (only if applicable under sector-specific rules)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DPI issues a written request for clarification or amendment of the dossier, the investor must supplement the dossier within the stated period (usually 10 working days). If DPI fails to issue a decision within the prescribed time, the investor may file a complaint under the Law on Administrative Procedures and may also submit a reminder letter to the DPI General Director. An administrative appeal to the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee is available against any rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Submit Enterprise Registration Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (doanhnghiep.gov.vn) / Department of Planning and Investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), the legal representative uses a valid digital signature or eKYC to complete and submit the Application for Enterprise Registration on the National Business Registration Portal. The online system checks for name collision and sanctions. The applicant must verify that the registered office address is legally available, and that the business scope code ISIC 6920 is correctly entered together with the description for virtual CFO advisory and multicurrency ledger bookkeeping services. The fee of USD 50 equivalent is payable online unless exempted by local regulation.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration
Approved Investment Registration Certificate (if foreign-invested)
Company Charter in Vietnamese (with foreign investor signatures)
List of founding members and capital contribution ratio
Copies of passports / national ID cards of all members and legal representative
Appointment decision or resolution authorizing the legal representative (if any)
Certified copy of the registered office lease agreement or use document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is queried ('reflex' or deviation notice) by the Business Registration Division, the applicant must correct and re-submit the deficient items within 15 days. Failure to correct leads to rejection of the application, but the applicant may file a new complete dossier and/or appeal the refusal to the Director of Business Registration Administration within 30 days from the date of receipt of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receive Enterprise Registration Certificate and File Seal Sample Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment; National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) is issued online or in person. The company then must apply to a licensed seal-carving enterprise to produce its official corporate seal (without registration if not otherwise required under Law No. 59/2020, but the seal model and sample must be sent to the Business Registration Authority via the National Portal within the same day of sealing to be publicly published). Simultaneously, the company publishes its information and declaration of legal addresses on the National Business Registration Portal.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (recorded)
Seal-carving authorization letter
Seal sample notification form signed by legal representative
Copy of passport / ID of legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal sample notification is rejected or the seal-carving enterprise fails, the company must prepare a new seal sample and resubmit the notification. If the DPI refuses to publish the seal sample, the company may submit a written explanation and, if necessary, file a complaint with the provincial People's Committee or apply for judicial resolution in the provincial administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Tax Registration and Automatic Tax Code Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation; Provincial/City Tax Department (CCT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the ERC, the tax authority automatically issues a 13-digit tax code and information is linked to the national tax database. The company must then use the E-Tax portal to register for Declaration-based VAT accounting method, Corporate Income Tax finalization and, if applicable, payroll-related taxes. Foreign investors must open a capital contribution bank account and notify the tax authority within 15 days of account opening. Submission of the Circular Form 01-ĐK-TCT is handled electronically by the company.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Tax registration declaration (Form 01-ĐK-TCT)
Charter / Investment Registration Certificate (if foreign-invested)
Bank account opening certificate (after opening the account)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax administration system raises a mismatch between business information and tax records, the company must submit a correction via the tax authority's electronic portal, attaching supporting documentation. Repeated errors may subject to administrative sanctions but are curable by filing an adjustment within the time requested in the instruction letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establish Statutory Corporate Governance Records and Internal Control Manual
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company itself; Notarization optional; Board / Members Council
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Constitute the statutory corporate governance books: members register (registry of members with contribution schedules and maps of capital transfers), meeting minutes during the first organizational meeting, deliberations of Members Council, audited internal control manual, and records of officer appointments. The company also drafts the resolution on internal financial management, payroll policy, anti-money-laundering compliance system for virtual CFO and multi-currency ledger processing, and engages an insurance broker for professional indemnity if demanded by clients. The assembled statutory records must be kept at the registered office and made available to the enterprise registration authority and tax authorities upon inspection.
required_dossiers: Members register / ledger
Minutes of the founding meeting and first organizational meeting
Register of meetings and decisions of the Members Council
Internal control manual (including segregation of duties in bookkeeping)
Anti-money laundering policies (for virtual CFO / multi-currency operations)
Financial reporting calendar and tax due calendar
Public key infrastructure (PKI) digital certificates for statutory filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the statutory records are found defective during an inspection, the company must correct and re-establish the records with a corrective notice. Failure to maintain statutory records is an administrative violation under Article 60 of Decree No. 01/2021; rectification can be executed by passing a new members resolution and issuing minutes, and necessary backdated supporting evidence must be reconstructed lawfully to preserve integrity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Finance — General Department of Taxation and Department of Accounting and Auditing Standards; Ministry of Planning and Investment (for specialized services issued under Decree No. 17/2012/ND-CP on accounting services)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificate of Eligibility for Providing Accounting Services (Giấy chứng nhận đủ điều kiện kinh doanh dịch vụ kế toán) issued by the Ministry of Finance under Article 16 of Law on Accounting No. 88/2015/QH13 and Decree No. 17/2012/ND-CP (as amended by Decree No. 70/2015/ND-CP and Decree No. 155/2015/ND-CP). Additionally, the company must hold a valid legal representative who is a CPA or a practicing accountancy certificate holder, and must register the professional scope of bookkeeping, accounting preparation, and multi-currency ledger services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vietnam Environment Administration (VEA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE); Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for licensing scrutiny involving domestic wastewater discharge
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA: the business consists exclusively of office-based virtual CFO advisory and multicurrency ledger bookkeeping services, which do not fall within any directive technoeconomic activity requiring an Environmental Impact Assessment under Article 33 of the Law on Environmental Protection 2020. The operation is to be carried out in a rented or company-owned office space with no manufacturing processes and no industrial discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Only domestic wastewater from washrooms and municipal tap water is generated. The company must comply with National Technical Regulation on Domestic Wastewater — QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT (before discharge into wastewater collection systems) and must not cause foul odors to the neighborhood. Hazardous wastes (e.g., used printer cartridges and electronic waste) must be stored separately and transferred to certified waste treatment enterprises in accordance with Decree No. 40/2019/ND-CP and the regulations on hazardous waste management. Any future use of backup generators is subject to gaseous emission standards and permit application if installed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The office must obtain a Fire Safety Inspection Certificate / Fire Protection Acceptance (Giấy chứng nhận thẩm duyệt thiết kế và nghiệm thu về PCCC) from the Provincial Fire Prevention and Firefighting Police under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP. The site must be structurally sound for ordinary office use (no industrial load requirements), have emergency lighting, fire extinguishers, and clearly marked evacuation routes. The company must register the workplace with the Occupational Safety and Health Authority if there are any risk-prone machines, and provide basic occupational safety gear, first-aid equipment, and organization of annual occupational safety training under Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam; operational portals: e-Tax Online Filing (https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn), Electronic Invoice System (https://hoadon.dientu.gdt.gov.vn), and the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn); primary local supervisor is the provincial/city Tax Sub-Department of the LLC's registered head office.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign investors first file an investment dossier (where required under the Law on Investment 2020 for conditional sectors or large-scale projects) or proceed directly to the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) for an Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) under the Law on Enterprises 2020 (No. 59/2020/QH14), submitting the LLC charter, legal representative authorization, foreign-investor identity papers, and evidence of the registered head-office premises in Vietnam. Within 3 working days after ERC issuance, the DPI feeds data to the General Department of Taxation, which automatically assigns a 13-digit Tax Identification Number (Mã số thuế, MST); the LLC then completes its electronic tax registration in the e-Tax portal, opens a local corporate bank account, obtains a qualified electronic signature for tax submissions, and registers its electronic invoice template within statutory timeframes. For foreign entities that do not establish a permanent establishment in Vietnam and transact through local counterparties, Vietnam instead applies Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) withholding on remittances, with no separate TIN privilege; however, for the resident VN_LLC the MST is mandatory, automatic, and irrevocable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a Vietnamese foreign-invested LLC is a standalone corporate income tax (CIT) payer at the standard 20% rate and cannot elect pass-through treatment; no U.S.-style check-the-box election exists. Tax domicile follows a worldwide-income system for residents, with a foreign tax credit (FTC) for foreign-source income pursuant to the Law on Corporate Income Tax (amended by Law 71/2014/QH13), capped by the applicable Vietnamese CIT rate; there are no tax-exempt zones for the LLC's head-office model, and the special Export Processing Enterprise (EPE) regime is not available for service-sector companies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election is available under Vietnamese law. Statutory choices affecting tax identity include: (i) election of intra-group transfer-pricing methodology and documentation (e.g., TNMM or profit split on a profit-level indicator) under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP; (ii) election of the currency used in licensed service contracts, with VAT and CIT returns mandated in VND under the government's reference exchange rate; (iii) election to apply the treaty foreign tax credit for offshore CFO fees subject to source-country taxes; and (iv) for multinational groups covered by global minimum tax rules with effect for fiscal years from 2024, election of the Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT) safe harbour under Decree 154/2024/ND-CP.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT, locally Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng 'GTGT')
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Registration is compulsory for every LLC from the effective date of its Enterprise Registration Certificate; there is no turnover-based VAT registration threshold for corporate taxpayers. As statutory background, households and individual business households with annual revenue not exceeding VND 100 million are excluded from VAT under the VAT Law; this de minimis threshold is not available to a limited liability company and does not affect the mandatory, automatic registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: E-invoicing is mandatory nationwide since 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Every invoice issued by the LLC must be generated as structured XML data, digitally signed with an authorized electronic signature, and transmitted to the General Department of Taxation's centralized e-invoice portal (hoadon.dientu.gdt.gov.vn). The tax authority assigns an invoice authentication code to each e-invoice, and taxpayers must register their e-invoice template and issuance principles before first use; invoices issued without the authority-assigned code are not fiscal receipts, and businesses using ERP systems must integrate the e-Tax API for batch transmission of invoice metadata within the applicable tax declaration cycle. Digital stamping is realized through the tax-authority-issued invoice code string and the nationwide centralized archive, which gives the tax authority real-time visibility of each invoice; Stripe_Billing and Wise settlement reports are cross-checked against invoice codes and inward FX remittance records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 9(4) of the Ministry of Finance Circular No. 219/2013/TT-BTC, export services provided to a foreign organization or individual and not consumed in Vietnam are subject to 0% VAT. The LLC's fractional CFO advisory, multicurrency bookkeeping, and financial analytics qualify only if (i) the purchaser is a non-resident of Vietnam and has no fixed establishment in Vietnam through which the services are received; (ii) the services are wholly or substantially supplied outside Vietnam, with substantive value generated offshore; (iii) the LLC retains contract, e-invoice, inbound foreign-currency receipt, and work-product evidence; and (iv) the payment is received through a bank transfer denominated in foreign currency, with Stripe_Billing and Wise settlement flows satisfying this condition only when the receiving Vietnamese bank statement identifies the offshore payer and the credited FX amount. Input VAT on costs attributable to such zero-rated supply is creditable, and excess credit is refundable, with refund applications exceeding VND 300 million attracting in-person audit.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (required when any tangible deliverables accompany the services; for pure services it is substituted by service invoice and work-product records)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (only for physical exports of documentation or media)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Giấy báo Có) issued by the Vietnamese bank for the foreign-currency payment received from each offshore client
Service Export Contract or Statement of Work identifying the foreign non-resident buyer, service scope, place of consumption, and fee schedule
Valid electronic service invoice issued to the overseas client and registered with the e-invoice system, including the authority-coded XML record
Bank statement or settlement report from Stripe_Billing or Wise showing the payer name and the FX transfer being credited to the LLC's Vietnamese bank account
Work-product or engagement deliverables evidencing offshore utilization of the CFO advice and accounting records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The tax authority reconstructs claimed export zero-rating whenever an invoice lacks matching FX inward remittance within 180 days; Stripe_Billing and Wise settlement flows are high-scrutiny because the taxpayer must prove that the beneficiary of record is the Vietnamese LLC and not an aggregate payment intermediary. Mis-constructed zero-rated invoices are recharacterized as taxable domestic services, with output VAT reassessed at 10% of the full gross fee; the tax authority adds late-payment interest at 0.03% per day, administrative penalties of VND 20–25 million for defective documentation, and 1–3 times the understated tax for deliberate under-declaration under Law 38/2019/QH14. Criminal liability for organized export-invoice fraud arises under the Penal Code on tax evasion, with imprisonment up to 20 years, confiscation of illegally obtained VAT refunds, extension of the statute of limitations from 5 years to 10 years, and publication of the compliance default. The clawback reach is retroactive to the tax period of the mis-claimed export fee, and the recovered VAT cannot be credited against subsequent refundable input VAT.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam – SBV), acting through its Foreign Exchange Administration Department and provincial branches, together with the Ministry of Finance for concurrent tax-related FX remittance controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime with current-account convertibility for VND. Under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange (No. 06/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 as amended) and SBV Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN, all payments, transfers and remittances for current-account transactions (trade in services, including management consultancy and virtual CFO services) are freely convertible and may be settled through SBV-licensed credit institutions without prior SBV approval. Capital-account transactions, including inbound equity contributions into a foreign-invested LLC and shareholder loans, require prior investment registration, opening of a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA), and compliance with the SBV's foreign-exchange control procedures. Profit remittance abroad is permitted once per year, after the audited financial statements and final corporate-income-tax settlement for the fiscal year, provided the LLC has no accumulated losses, has satisfied all tax and social-insurance obligations, and remits via the licensed foreign-currency account or DICA. VND is non-deliverable onshore; offshore NDF referencing VND is not recognized by SBV and may not be booked through a Vietnamese licensed bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Service-export proceeds (including cross-border virtual CFO advisory fees) denominated in foreign currency must be transferred to a licensed bank foreign-currency account in Viet Nam within 180 days from the date the service is completed and invoiced, as set out in Article 10 of Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN. There is no mandatory statutory conversion ratio: the LLC may retain the foreign currency in its account, sell it to the licensed bank, or use it for approved outbound payments. However, SBV reporting on the foreign-currency flow must be submitted via the bank's electronic reporting system using the appropriate balance-of-payments purpose code. Any extension of the 180-day repatriation timeline requires a written SBV approval obtained before the deadline, supported by underlying service contracts and documentary evidence of the delay.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM with legal constraints. Offshore digital EMI platforms (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex) may be used as ancillary collection channels for receiving small-value cross-border client payments, but they cannot substitute for a licensed Vietnamese bank account and cannot legally open a domestic VND clearing account without an SBV credit-institution licence. For a foreign-invested LLC, all service-export proceeds must be ultimately repatriated to an onshore licensed-bank foreign-currency account under Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN. Wise is workable for inbound USD/EUR collections into a Wise Business multicurrency balance followed by a monthly SWIFT MT103 sweep to the Vietnamese licensed bank; Stripe Billing should be configured to settle to Wise, and the aggregated monthly settlement must be reconciled against the underlying client invoices to satisfy the 180-day repatriation rule and SBV purpose-code reporting. The LLC must maintain a clear audit trail from EMI statements, client invoices, and the onshore bank credit advice.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person presence is generally mandatory for the legal representative (Chairman of the Members' Council or the General Director) of a foreign-invested LLC at the selected bank branch for the first onboarding. Most tier-1 banks require the original passport, the original notarised Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), the LLC charter, and a valid lease agreement. Remote opening is possible only in exceptional cases where the bank has an existing relationship and the foreign shareholder is a regulated entity; instead, the LLC may appoint a Vietnamese-resident legal representative or an authorised signatory under a notarised power of attorney, but the foreign investor/director must still appear by video conference for a compliance interview with the bank's AML officer. SBV policy effectively requires a physical branch visit for the corporate account opening and for signing the FX/trade documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) opacity – the bank cannot fully identify the natural persons ultimately owning or controlling the foreign-invested LLC, or the declared shareholder structure contains layers of shell entities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed UBO declaration form on the bank's template; corporate registry extract/certificate of incorporation of each shareholder; passport copies of all UBOs and legal representatives; organisational chart with shareholding percentages; source-of-wealth statement for each UBO backed by bank statements, tax records, or asset sale contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for the foreign equity capital contribution is unverifiable – the remitting account is not in the name of the declared foreign investor or shows unrelated third-party deposits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six to twelve months of bank statements of the investing entity/individual; board resolution or capital-contribution resolution; audited financial statements or business registration of the investor; signed capital-contribution agreement; SWIFT MT103 of the inward transfer; declaration of source of wealth and source of funds; confirmation that the remitter name matches the IRC and the DICA beneficiary exactly.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: GDP/AML risk-tier mismatch – licensed status of the LLC (virtual CFO / accounting services) raises concerns that the entity may be providing shadow accounting or moving client funds through its own account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the Enterprise Registration Certificate with the official line of business 6920; valid tax identification number and VAT registration; sample client engagement agreements with clear scope (advisory, bookkeeping, fractional CFO); illustrative invoices with fee schedules; a written confirmation that the LLC never holds, sweeps, or commingles client funds; updated balance sheet and profit-and-loss showing service-fee revenue only; professional-indemnity insurance certificate if available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered-office and operational-substance mismatch – the LLC is registered at an address that the bank cannot physically verify or that appears inconsistent with the stated staffing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Validated lease agreement in the LLC's name; utility bill (electricity, internet, water) not older than three months; photographs of the office; payroll records and labour contracts of Vietnamese resident employees; corporate tax filings (PIT monthly schedules) proving active substaff; business registration certificate with the same registered address.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected transaction-flow red flags – projected turnover from cross-border virtual CFO services is high relative to equity capital, or invoices are issued to jurisdiction counterparts with elevated correspondent-banking risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed 12-month cash-flow forecast; list of target clients with corporate identifiers of each client; master service agreements with two or three anchor clients; invoicing and payment-terms policy; tax-planning memorandum showing the CIT and VAT treatment of each service stream; signed declaration that no cash transactions or third-party payments will be routed through the account; irrevocable instruction to the bank to flag any non-conforming transfers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign investor must first obtain the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC). The LLC then opens a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank in the name of the LLC. The share capital contribution must be wired via SWIFT MT103 from the investor's bank account in which the remitter name matches the investor name stated in the IRC; the wire must reference the 'Capital contribution to the LLC' purpose code prescribed under SBV's statistical reporting regime (the bank will map it to the applicable BoP classification). The bank will credit the DICA, issue a Foreign Investment Confirmation or capital-contribution receipt, and report to SBV. No physical remittance is required if the contribution is made in-kind; however, for cash injections each transfer must be registered in the DICA ledger. For any subsequent increase in charter capital, an amended IRC is required before additional wires are accepted. The LLC may also receive shareholder loans in foreign currency, but such loans must be registered under SBV regulations and cannot exceed 30% of charter capital for shorter-term intra-group loans, otherwise they are subject to the enterprise loan ratio and loan-registration requirements.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for imported software subscriptions, subcontracting services, or international licensing fees uses the SWIFT MT103 channel via the licensed bank, with the LLC's foreign-currency account or the conversion of VND at the interbank rate. For each disbursement, the bank requires the underlying service contract, the vendor invoice, a certificate of service completion where applicable, and the correct BoP purpose code (e.g., 'payment for consulting services', 'software licensing royalties'), together with the Vietnamese corporate income tax and VAT obligations — including 1% or 5% FCT (foreign contractor tax) withholding for non-resident vendors, as applicable. Commercial letters of credit (LCs) are generally not used for services; they are reserved for physical trade, and the LLC shifting to multicurrency ledger bookkeeping is unlikely to require LC issuance. Payment orders should be batched and reported through the bank's corporate e-banking platform to maintain a clean audit trail. For cross-border service disbursements exceeding USD 500,000 equivalent, the bank may require a board resolution / members' council resolution authorising the payment and, for payments to related parties, transfer-pricing documentation or a TP policy statement to comply with Circular 132/2020/TT-BTC.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore VND/USD FX forward contracts pursuant to SBV Circular 02/2021/TT-NHNN, with a maximum tenor of 365 days, requiring a genuine underlying current-account or capital-account exposure; used to lock the exchange rate on expected service-export proceeds or import payments.

Onshore VND/USD FX swap contracts (both principal and interest) with a licensed bank, permitted for up to 365 days on the same underlying-real-demand basis; commonly used to convert temporary USD liquidity into VND and reverse the position on maturity.

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps between USD and VND are available at the bank's product committee discretion for sophisticated borrowers, but SBV treats such structures as ordinary OTC derivatives to be documented under ISDA or a local master agreement, and in practice most banks restrict availability to tenors under 365 days with collateral requirements.

Offshore nondeliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD/VND are NOT permissible onshore and may not be entered into by an SBV-licensed credit institution; an onshore VND corporate may only hedge with deliverable onshore products, and the LLC should prohibit any Vietnamese counterparty from booking an NDF. The LLC may use offshore NDFs only indirectly through its foreign parent for risk-sharing, provided no Vietnamese entity is a party and settlement is made wholly outside Viet Nam without affecting the DICA.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) – Business Registration Office of the province where the LLC is domiciled
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year filers, on or before 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines for late or inaccurate filing; repeated non-filing for two consecutive years together with unreachability at the registered office permits DPI to revoke the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation via provincial/city Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 30 January each year for continuing enterprises; new LLCs pay within 30 days of Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance. Fee tier is USD 39–118 depending on charter capital; typical LLC rate is approximately USD 79.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest of 0.03% per day on arrears; repeated non-payment may trigger tax debt enforcement, suspension of tax invoice usage, and administrative strike-off of the enterprise.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Tax Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation via provincial/city Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 March for calendar-year taxpayers; generally the 30th day of the third month after fiscal year-end, extended to the next business day if falling on a weekend or legal holiday.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines range from VND 1,000,000 to VND 20,000,000; late payment interest accrues at 0.03% per day of unpaid tax; material evasion may lead to criminal liability and license revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department and DPI; a copy is also submitted to the Statistics Office where required.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year LLCs, no later than 31 March. Financial statements must be prepared in Vietnamese under VAS and audited because of foreign-invested status.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-submission triggers administrative fines up to VND 30,000,000; continued non-compliance may lead to imposed tax assessments and is a ground for DPI license revocation proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Independent Statutory Audit Report (Báo cáo kiểm toán) – audited financial statement package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not filed as a standalone return; the audit opinion must accompany the annual financial statement package submitted to the Tax Department and DPI.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit must be completed and audited financial statements delivered in time for the 90-day annual FS deadline; for calendar-year filers, by 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain the mandatory independent audit for a foreign-invested LLC is treated as non-compliance; administrative fines up to VND 50,000,000 may apply, and audited FS filing with DPI/Tax will not be accepted as compliant.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No revenue, asset, or employee threshold applies: every foreign-invested LLC in Vietnam is mandatorily audited annually by a licensed independent audit firm under the Law on Enterprise and the Accounting Law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) – Local GAAP, principally Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS may be applied only where the Ministry of Finance roadmap or specific eligibility criteria permit.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No standalone annual UBO return is filed in Vietnam. The LLC must maintain an accurate beneficial-ownership register under AML Law 2022; any share transfer or change of ultimate beneficial owner must be recorded in the Register of Members, and a business-registration change application must be filed with DPI within 10 days of the change. Annually, the company secretary or Virtual CFO should reconcile UBO and shareholding data and confirm accuracy with the Board before the Annual Enterprise Report deadline.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250–USD 1,200 per year (physical registered address plus corporate secretarial/agent support in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200–USD 3,500 per year (small/medium LLC providing outsourced virtual CFO services; actual fee depends on transaction volume, multi-currency bookkeeping, and complexity)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT rate is 20%. Virtual CFO/consulting services (ISIC 6920, NAICS 541219) do not normally qualify for high-tech or software tax holidays. If the LLC separately invests in an eligible encouraged sector (e.g., high-tech application, supporting industry, software production, or an economic zone/incentivized industrial zone), it may receive 10% CIT for up to 15 years, a 2-year exemption and 50% reduction for up to 4 years, and a 20% rate for up to 10 years. Such incentives are territorial (project-specific) and require a separate Certificate of Investment Incentive; outsourced CFO bookkeeping fees attributable to non-incentivized activities are taxed at 20%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual CIT finalization return: Form 03/TNDN. Electronic filing via the General Department of Taxation eTax portal (https://etax.gdt.gov.vn); paper filing is accepted only in exceptional cases authorized by the local tax office.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the last day of the third month after the end of the fiscal year (e.g., 31 March for a 31 December year-end). A different fiscal year may be approved by tax authorities but the three-month rule still applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered Vietnamese trade name of the LLC as stated in the Enterprise Registration Certificate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact Vietnamese legal name; if a foreign shareholder appoints a legal representative or signatory, attach the notarized power of attorney to the tax file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 10- or 13-digit tax code issued by the General Department of Taxation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC files under its own MST; non-resident shareholders do not enter their foreign tax ID here. A Vietnamese MST is mandatory before any payment, invoice, or customs declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered business address in Vietnam where the accounting records and management are located.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical office and substance are required. If the LLC claims no fixed place in Vietnam while being managed from abroad, the tax authority may recharacterize or deny incentives.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calendar year or approved fiscal year-end, stated in DD/MM/YYYY format.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned LLCs must follow the Vietnamese tax year, not the home-country tax year, unless a separate fiscal year is approved.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Select 1 for ordinary finalization or 2 for additional finalization. Additional filings require the original return number and reason code.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use additional finalization only for genuine adjustments; a voluntary adjustment after inspection still may attract late-payment interest on the underpaid amount.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: [A1] - Revenue from sale of goods and services
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accrual-basis gross revenue from virtual CFO advisory, bookkeeping, multicurrency reconciliation, and related services, excluding output VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All revenues must be recorded in VND. Foreign-currency receipts from Stripe or Wise must be converted at the ruling exchange rate on the transaction date; unrecognized offshore receipts are a red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Actual operating expenses with valid VAT invoices: salaries, software, office rent, outsourced IT, bank and payment-rail fees, depreciation, and statutory contributions. Non-deductible items include fines, unsubstantiated accruals, and entertainment above legal caps.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border service fees, royalties, and interest paid to foreign parties must have proper Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) withholding; otherwise the expense may be disallowed and the LLC can be penalized as the withholding agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest income, foreign-exchange gains, gains on disposal of assets, and any non-recurring income not in A1.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all income from Vietnam and from offshore clients if the foreign shareholder exercises central management in Vietnam; offshore income attribution must be supported by substance and contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: C1 records income exempt from CIT; C2 records the tax loss brought forward from prior years, limited to a maximum of five consecutive years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward claims must be evidenced by audited financial statements. A foreign-owned LLC cannot carry losses to the shareholder or from a foreign head office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: C3 is taxable income after exemptions and loss carryforward; C4 is the applicable rate (20% standard or an incentive rate).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a CIT incentive is claimed, attach the investment certificate and sector qualification. For pure outsourced CFO services, the standard 20% rate is the safe position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: C5 is calculated tax; C6 is the sum of quarterly provisional payments; C7 is the net additional tax due or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Quarterly provisional payments must equal at least 80% of the final tax liability; otherwise late-payment interest at 0.03% per day applies to the shortfall. Dividends should be declared only after finalization and audited profit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP: warning for 1-5 days; administrative fines escalate to VND 50 million for delays exceeding 90 days; late payment interest accrues at 0.03% per day. Under-declaration found in inspection attracts penalty of 1-3 times the evaded tax plus interest, and criminal prosecution under Penal Code Article 200 if intentional concealment exceeds VND 100 million.
